parsed.name: 串口数据接口组件
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于实验控制中的串口数据通道访问。它提供查询串口缓冲区可读字节数和按字节读取数据的能力，适合在基于 SCPI 的仪器通信流程中处理底层数据收发。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component for accessing a serial data channel in laboratory control workflows. It provides functions to query available bytes in the serial buffer and read raw bytes, making it suitable for low-level data transfer in SCPI-based instrument communication.

actions.description: 获取串口数据接口中当前可读取的字节数。
actions.description_en: Get the number of bytes currently available to read from the serial data interface.

actions.description: 从串口数据接口读取指定数量的原始字节，可设置超时时间。
actions.description_en: Read a specified number of raw bytes from the serial data interface, with an optional timeout.
